ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r6.claim: Verses 11–26 describe the foremost and the Paradise gifts and character qualities that qualify them for that rank.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p135/r6.anchor: The details of the gifts and favours of their Lord which they shall receive in Paradise are recounted

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p141/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p141/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p141/r1.claim: As leaders and pioneers, the foremost are rewarded first and brought nearest to God in gardens of delight, with paradises corresponding to their ranks rather than a divine court.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p141/r1.anchor: their reward is mentioned the foremost

RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r1.claim: The restriction applies among the three human groups: the forerunners reach the highest degree of nearness, while other groups may also be near at lower, unbounded degrees; angels can be called near as well.
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r1.anchor: أولئك المقربون } يقتضي الحصر فينبغي أن لا يكون غيرهم مقربا

RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r2.claim: One explanation places the forerunners near the gardens while the people of the right are still heading there and receiving their books after an easy reckoning.
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r2.anchor: المراد السابقون مقربون من الجنات حال كون أصحاب اليمين متوجهين إلى طريق الجنة

RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r3.claim: Another explanation makes their nearness to God in Paradise a continuing ascent: as others approach, the forerunners rise further, reaching the highest levels as the others reach the houris.
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r3.anchor: قربهم إلى الله في الجنة وأصحاب اليمين بعد متوجهون إلى ما وصل إليه المقربون

RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.claim: The discourse first names those affected by the warnings, then explains the forerunners before the people of the left because the forerunners' merit deserves priority in this exposition.
RAZI-FULL:v29p128/r4.anchor: عند البيان فذكر السابق لفضيلته وفضيلة حاله

STUDYQURAN:56:11/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r1.claim: One reading takes the foremost as brought nigh in Gardens of bliss.
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r1.anchor: These verses could mean that the foremost are

STUDYQURAN:56:11/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r2.speaker: Z
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r2.claim: Another view says they are brought nigh to the Divine Throne.
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r2.anchor: brought nigh to the Divine Throne (Z)

STUDYQURAN:56:11/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r3.speaker: Aj, JJ
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r3.claim: Another view says they are brought nigh unto God Himself.
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r3.anchor: brought nigh unto God Himself (Aj, JJ)

STUDYQURAN:56:11/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r4.speaker: Ibn ʿAjībah
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAjībah says the brought-nigh were more numerous in earlier times, not greater in quality.
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r4.anchor: Ibn ʿAjībah notes that the ones brought nigh were greater in earlier times with regard to quantity, not quality.

STUDYQURAN:56:11/r5.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r5.speaker: some
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r5.claim: Some consider people near the end of time higher in degree because they awaken amid heedlessness and strive amid lassitude, earning a rank unavailable to others despite lacking earlier supports.
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r5.anchor: Those toward the end of time are considered by some to be of a higher degree, because they have awakened in a time of heedlessness and exerted themselves in a time of lassitude.

STUDYQURAN:56:11/r6.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r6.speaker: the Prophet
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r6.claim: The Prophet tells his Companions that in their time omitting one tenth of what is commanded brings ruin, whereas later fulfilling one tenth brings salvation; no grading is stated.
STUDYQURAN:56:11/r6.anchor: the Prophet said to his Companions

BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r18.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r18.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r18.claim: The Forerunners are brought near: their ranks approach the Mighty Throne, their stations are raised, and their purified souls ascend to the precincts of holiness.
BURSEVI:v9p258#2/r18.anchor: أي الذين قربت إلى العرش العظيم درجاتهم وأعليت مراتبهم ورقيت إلى حظائر القدس نفوسهم الزكية

TABATABAI:56:10/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10/r3.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:10/r3.claim: Another parse makes the first السابقون the subject, the second an emphatic repetition, and “those are the brought-near” the predicate.

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.speaker: رسول الله
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.claim: In a report from Ibn Abbas, the Prophet says Gabriel identified the verse with Ali and his Shi'a, who precede to Paradise and are brought near through God's honor.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r5.anchor: بإسناده إلى ابن عباس قال سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.claim: A report in al-Uyun transmitted from Ali says that “the foremost, the foremost; those are the brought-near” was revealed concerning him.
TABATABAI:56:10#2/r7.anchor: وفي العيون في باب ما جاء عن الرضا عليه السلام من الأخبار المجموعة بإسناده عن علي عليه السلام قال

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r1.claim: These verses begin detailing the outcome on the Resurrection for each of the three classes just named.
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r1.anchor: بيان الآيات تفصل ما ينتهي إليه حال كل واحد من الأزواج الثلاثة

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r2.claim: أولئك points back to the foremost group.

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r3.claim: The preferred parse makes أولئك المقربون a new subject-predicate sentence, fitting the passage's division of humanity followed by each group's outcome.
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r3.anchor: وأول الوجوه الثلاثة أوجه بالنظر إلى سياق تقسيم الناس إلى ثلاثة أزواج

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r4.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r4.claim: One alternative makes the clause the predicate of والسابقون.

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r5.speaker: قيل
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r5.claim: Another parse treats أولئك as the subject and في جنات النعيم as its predicate.
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r5.anchor: وقيل مبتدأ خبره في جنات النعيم

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r6.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r6.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r6.claim: Nearness and distance first describe bodies by spatial relation, then extend to time and other comparisons, and finally to nonphysical realities.
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r6.anchor: والقرب والبعد معنيان متضائفان تتصف بهما الأجسام بحسب النسبة المكانية

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r7.claim: God's nearness describes His encompassing all things; being nearer to a thing than it is to itself is the most remarkable conception of nearness.
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r7.anchor: وقد اعتبر القرب وصفا له تعالى بما له من الإحاطة بكل شيء

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r8.claim: A servant approaches God through good works by entering the reach of divine mercy as causes of misery and deprivation fall away; God brings the servant near by granting special honor, forgiveness, and mercy.
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r8.anchor: فالعبد يتقرب بصالح العمل إلى الله سبحانه وهو وقوعه في معرض شمول الرحمة الإلهية

TABATABAI:56:11-12/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r9.claim: The brought-near are the highest rank of the blessed, as the link to the foremost indicates; attaining this rank requires complete servitude.
TABATABAI:56:11-12/r9.anchor: فالمقربون هم النمط الأعلى من أهل السعادة

TABRISI:56:11-16/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:56:11-16/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:56:11-16/r3.claim: Those who race to obedience are brought near to God's mercy, the highest ranks, abundant reward, and honor.
TABRISI:56:11-16/r3.anchor: أي والسابقون إلى الطاعات يقربون إلى رحمة الله في أعلى المراتب وإلى جزيل ثواب الله

THALABI:v9p202/r13.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p202/r13.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p202/r13.claim: These people are brought near to God in the Gardens of Bliss.
THALABI:v9p202/r13.anchor: أولئك المقربون إلى الله في جنات النعيم

THALABI:v9p203/r1.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p203/r1.speaker: رجل من أهل الكوفة
THALABI:v9p203/r1.claim: A Kufan informant says that when one of the foremost, brought-near residents leaves his Paradise dwelling, his light identifies him to those below.
THALABI:v9p203/r1.anchor: بلغني أنه إذا خرج رجل من السابقين المقربين من مسكنه في الجنة

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r12.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r12.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r12.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās compares the brought-near to the prophets and messengers.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r12.anchor: قال ابن عباس: مثل النبيين والمرسلين

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r13.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r13.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r13.claim: Al-Kalbī says their destination is Eden.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r14.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r14.speaker: أهل المعاني
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r14.claim: The specialists in meaning describe their reward as God’s abundant recompense and great honor.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v21p217#3/r14.anchor: وقال أهل المعاني: جزيل ثواب الله وعظيم كرامته

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:11/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:11/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:56:11/r1.claim: The forerunners are brought near to God’s honor.

QASHANI:56:10-14/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:56:10-14/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:56:10-14/r3.claim: The brought-near have realized Real existence after annihilation.
QASHANI:56:10-14/r3.anchor: حال التحقق بالوجود الحقاني بعد الفناء

ELMALILI:56:1-24/r23.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r23.speaker: author
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r23.claim: These are the people brought near to God and granted the highest rank and station in His presence.
ELMALILI:56:1-24/r23.anchor: Allah teâlâ indinde yakınlığa, en yüksek mertebe ve makāma erdirilmiş zatlardır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r1.speaker: unnamed commentators
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r1.claim: Some interpretations identify the foremost as particular people: the first believers, the earliest emigrants, or Companions who prayed toward both qiblas.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r1.anchor: “Allah ve resulüne ilk iman edenler, ilk muhacirler, iki kıbleye doğru da namaz kılmış sahâbîler” şeklinde belirli kimselerin kastedildiği yorumları yapılmış

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r2.speaker: İbn Atıyye
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r2.claim: Ibn Atiyya takes the foremost broadly: all people who lead in good deeds and avoiding evil in life, thereby deserving to lead in afterlife felicity.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:56:11/r2.anchor: İbn Atıyye esasen âyetin dünyada iken iyilik yapma ve kötülüklerden sakınma hususunda öncü konumunda olan

QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r1.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r1.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r1.claim: They are called those brought near, not those who draw near: God's drawing them near precedes their own effort, the mark of the station of union.
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r1.anchor: لم يقل : { المتقربون } بل قال : أولئك المقربون - وهذاعين الجمع

QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r3.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r3.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r3.claim: Their nearness is honor, not spatial distance: selves near paradise, hearts near the Real and gnosis, and spirits in witnessing; God transcends nearness, distance, separation, and union.
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r3.anchor: مقربة نفوسهم من الجنة وقلوبهم إلى الحق . مقربة قلوبهم من بساط المعرفة ، وأرواحهم من ساحات الشهود

QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r4.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r4.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r4.claim: Another reading is that they are brought near in their allotments, shares, and states, though the Real remains beyond even their purified states.
QUSHAYRI:v3p274/r4.anchor: ويقال : مقربون ولكن من حظوظهم ونصيبهم . وأحوالهم - وإن صفت - فالحق وراء الوراء

ITQAN:v4p469/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v4p469/r5.speaker: author
ITQAN:v4p469/r5.claim: In the second category, an interpreter names an instance of a general class: the unjust neglect duties or commit prohibitions, the middle group performs duties and avoids prohibitions, and the foremost exceed in good deeds; these are examples, not exhaustive definitions.
ITQAN:v4p469/r5.anchor: مثاله ما نقل في قوله تعالى ﴿ ثم أورثنا الكتاب الذين اصطفينا ﴾ الآية فمعلوم أن الظالم لنفسه

TUSTARI:56:11/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:56:11/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:56:11/r1.claim: The brought-near occupy stations of closeness and intimacy; they were foremost in worldly faith: prophets in God, and the truthful and martyrs among the Companions and others in the prophets.
TUSTARI:56:11/r1.anchor: في منازل القرب وروح الأنس، وهم الذين سبقوا في الدنيا، فسبق الأنبياء إلى الإيمان بالله

FARRA:v3p121/r10.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p121/r10.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p121/r10.claim: Alternatively, the second السابقون intensifies the first, and أولئك المقربون supplies the predicate.
FARRA:v3p121/r10.anchor: وإن شئت جعلت الثانية تشديدا للأولى، ورفعت بقوله: أولئك المقربون

NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.speaker: أبو إسحاق
NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.claim: Abu Ishaq parses the first forerunners as a subject and the second as its adjective, with those are the brought-near as predicate; alternatively the second is the predicate, meaning forerunners to God's mercy.
NAHHAS:v4p323/r11.anchor: أحدهما أن يكون السابقون الأول مرفوعا بالابتداء والثاني من صفته وخبر الابتداء أولئك المقربون ويجوز عنده أن يكون السابقون الأول مرفوعا بالابتداء

NAHHAS:v4p323/r12.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p323/r12.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p323/r12.claim: Al-Nahhas rejects making ūlāʾika al-muqarrabūn an adjective: demonstratives are more definite than nouns with alif-lām; the phrase is instead apposition or a second predicate.
NAHHAS:v4p323/r12.anchor: قال أبو جعفر قوله أولئك صفة غلط عندي لأن ما فيه الألف واللام لا يوصف بالمبهم

ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.claim: One parsing makes the first السابقون a subject, the second an emphatic repetition, and أولئك المقربون the predicate.
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r2.anchor: والسابقون الأول رفع بالابتداء، والثاني توكيد، ويكون الخبر (أولئك المقربون)

ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.claim: Alternatively the first السابقون is the subject and the second its predicate: they preceded in obedience and in God's mercy, and those brought near describe them.
ZAJJAJ:v5p109/r3.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون السابقون الأول رفعا بالابتداء. ويكون خبره (السابقون) الثاني

SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.claim: Samarrāʾī identifies the foremost, brought-near ones as the highest of creation and contrasts their reward with that of the companions of the right.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR:r7#9/r10.anchor: في التفريق بين نعيم السابقين المقربين وهم أعلى الخلق ونعيم أصحاب اليمين

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p734/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p734/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p734/r4.claim: Being brought near in al-Waqiʿa is an added degree beyond being honored in al-Saffat.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.claim: The sūra is Meccan and follows al-Raḥmān, which paired punishment for sinners with bliss for believers; its two pairs of gardens distinguish lower- and higher-ranking believers, matching the three groups named at this sūra’s start and the groups at its end.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p74/r13.anchor: هذه السورة مكية، ومناسبتها لما قبلها تضمن العذاب للمجرمين، والنعيم للمؤمنين

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.claim: The two gardens below the first pair complete three human ranks: unbelievers, believers of lesser rank, and superior believers; the sūra opens with the three groups and ends with the companions of the right and deniers.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p75/r1.anchor: فانقسم العالم بذلك إلى كافر ومؤمن مفضول ومؤمن فاضل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.claim: A second parsing treats the second al-sābiqūn as verbal emphasis, with the predicate in what follows.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r11.anchor: وأن يكون السابقون تأكيدا لفظيا، والخبر فيما بعد ذلك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.claim: A further analysis distinguishes those foremost in faith from those foremost in reaching Paradise; the second term can be a predicate or adjective, with the predicate after it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p78/r13.anchor: وأن يكون متعلق السبق الأول مخالفا للسبق الثاني. والسابقون إلى الإيمان السابقون إلى الجنة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r2.claim: Ulāʾika points to the foremost, whose stations and ranks in Paradise have risen near the Throne.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p79/r2.anchor: أولئك: إشارة إلى السابقين المقربين الذين علت منازلهم وقربت درجاتهم في الجنة من العرش

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r1.claim: The clause is a topic and predicate, serving as an explanatory resumption.

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.claim: A competing parse makes the first السابقون the topic, the repeated word its emphatic confirmation, and أولئك المقربون the predicate; the author rejects it as weakening the division, the rhetoric, and the following contrast.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r2.anchor: وقيل ( السابقون ) السابق مبتدأ ( والسابقون ) اللاحق تأكيد له وما بعد خبر

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r3.claim: أولئك points to the forerunners; its distant demonstrative form despite the nearby antecedent signals their exalted rank.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r3.anchor: والإشارة بأولئك إلى السابقين وما فيه من معنى البعد مع قرب العهد بالمشار

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r4.claim: المقربون describes those granted closeness and standing with God.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r4.anchor: و ( المقربون ) من القربة بمعنى الخطوة أي أولئك الموصوفون بذلك النعت الجليل

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r5.claim: Other commentators explain the close ones as those whose ranks have been brought near to the Throne.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r5.anchor: وقال غير واحد : المراد الذين قربت إلى العرش درجاتهم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.speaker: الإرشاد
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.claim: Al-Irshad takes each group label as the predicate of an omitted topic: the expected next step after dividing people is to name the categories, then describe them.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r6.anchor: الذي تقتضيه جزالة التنزيل أن قوله تعالى

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.speaker: الإرشاد
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.claim: On al-Irshad’s analysis, the descriptions of the first two groups are parenthetical previews of their eventual states, while the forerunners receive their description immediately and need no preview.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r7.anchor: خلا أنه لما أخر بيان أحوال القسمين الأولين عقب كلا منهما بجملة معترضة بين القسمين

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.speaker: الإرشاد
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.claim: Al-Irshad parses السابقون as a topic, with explicit repetition for grandeur; أولئك begins a second topic or is appositional, and المقربون supplies the predicate.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r8.anchor: فقوله تعالى : ( السابقون ) مبتدأ والإظهار في مقام الإضمار للتفخيم

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.claim: The author finds al-Irshad’s analysis more natural: after division, the categories themselves are expected as the primary point, rather than a judgment about them or their descriptions.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r9.anchor: والذي يتبادر للنظر الجليل ما في الإرشاد من كون أصحاب الميمنة وكذا كل من الأخيرين

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.claim: A criticism says al-Irshad’s parse does not itself give detailed states, but identifies the groups while alluding generally to their astonishing conditions; it also asks why the two questions about the other groups would be omitted from the detail.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r10.anchor: وقيل عليه : إنه ليس في جعل جملتي الاستفهام وقوله سبحانه : ( السابقون ) إخبارا لما قبلها

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.claim: A further analysis allows the two questions to modify their preceding group labels after an implied saying, and السابقون likewise to modify its antecedent; the following clause then resumes explanatorily.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r11.anchor: بل يجوز أن يكون كل منهما صفة لما قبلها بتقدير القول كأنه قيل : فأحدها أصحاب الميمنة

ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.claim: Against the objection that this adjective analysis deletes a relative pronoun and part of its clause, the author denies that أل is relative when it does not indicate a new occurrence.
ALUSI-FULL:v27p132#3/r12.anchor: وما يقال : إن في هذا الوجه حذف الموصول مع بعض أجزاء الصلة يجاب عنه بمنع كون أل في الوصف

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p9#3/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p9#3/r1.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p9#3/r1.claim: The foremost are those brought near to God.

BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r6.claim: They are drawn near through elevated degrees and raised ranks in the Garden of Bliss.
BAYDAWI-FULL:56:11-14/r6.anchor: الذين قربت درجاتهم في الجنة وأعليت مراتبهم

BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r8.claim: God chose and brought them near; without His act of drawing them close, they would not have become forerunners.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r8.anchor: الذين اصطفاهم الله تعالى للسبق فأرادهم لقربه أو أنعم عليهم بقربه

BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r9.speaker: الرازي
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r9.claim: Al-Rāzī describes the close as freed from self-interest: all religious and worldly deeds and both divine and human rights are treated as God’s rights; he distinguishes those absorbed in awe from those entrusted with easier service.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p404/r9.anchor: قال الرازي في اللوامع : المقربون تخلصوا من نفوسهم

DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas transmits the Prophet’s saying that the foremost enter the mosque first and leave it last.
DURR-FULL:v8p6/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: {والسابقون السابقون أولئك المقربون} أول من يدخل المسجد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r5.claim: The clause about the brought-near is a resumed explanatory answer to the question raised by the praise of the foremost: what is their reward?
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r5.anchor: مستأنفة استئنافا بيانيا لأنها جواب عما يثيره قوله : { والسابقون السابقون } من تساؤل السامع عن أثر التنويه بهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.claim: The passage begins detailing the recompense of the three classes through a نشر بعد اللف arrangement, deliberately disordered by proximity of meanings and then relative priority.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r6.anchor: ابتداء تفصيل لجزاء الأصناف الثلاثة على طريقة النشر بعد اللف ، نشرا مشوشا تشويشا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r7.claim: Muqarrab is more emphatic than qarīb: its form implies selection and favor, and nearness to God is figurative treatment as a beloved person whose concerns receive care.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r7.anchor: والمقرب : أبلغ من القريب لدلالة صيغته على الاصطفاء والاجتباء ، وذلك قرب مجازي

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r8.speaker: النبي
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r8.claim: A sacred hadith describes drawing near through supererogatory worship until God loves the servant and becomes his hearing, sight, hand, and foot; Ibn ʿĀshūr uses it to explain figurative nearness.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p287/r8.anchor: ولا يزال عبدي يتقرب إلي بالنوافل حتى أحبه فإذا أحببته كنت سمعه الذي يسمع به

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r1.claim: The object of being brought near is omitted because nearness to God’s care and favor is obvious; omitting its time and place generalizes it to worldly and otherworldly states.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r1.anchor: ولم يذكر متعلق { المقربون } لظهور أنه مقرب من الله ، أي من عنايته وتفضيله ، وكذلك لم يذكر زمان التقريب ولا مكانه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r2.claim: The demonstrative subject signals that the foremost deserve the following predicate because of their previously stated quality, as in the demonstrative in 2:5.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v27p288/r2.anchor: في جعل المسند إليه اسم إشارة تنبيه على أنهم أحرياء بما يخبر عنه من أجل الوصف الوارد قبل اسم الإشارة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r4.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r4.claim: أولئك المقربون is subject and predicate; on the adjective analysis above it stands as that clause's predicate.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r4.anchor: وقوله: أولئك المقربون ابتداء وخبر، وهو في موضع الخبر على قول من قال: السابقون الثاني صفة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r5.claim: The near ones are near to God in the Garden of Eden.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r5.anchor: و: المقربون معناه من الله في جنة عدن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r16.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r16.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r16.claim: Al-muqarrabūn designates the highest human rank in the afterlife.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p240/r16.anchor: و: المقربون عبارة عن أعلى منازل البشر في الآخرة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r7.speaker: أبو سليمان الدمشقي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r7.claim: Abū Sulaymān al-Dimashqī says the ‘brought near’ are near God, in the shade of His Throne and His presence.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p133#2/r7.anchor: قال أبو سليمان الدمشقي يعني عند الله في ظل عرشه وجواره

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.claim: These views can all be true: the foremost are those who hasten to commanded good works; those who race to good in this life are foremost in honor in the next, since recompense matches deeds, and they are brought near in gardens.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p516/r9.anchor: وهذه الأقوال كلها صحيحة، فإن المراد بالسابقين هم المبادرون إلى فعل الخيرات كما أمروا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.speaker: عبد الله بن عمرو
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.claim: Abdullah ibn Amr says angels asked God to give them the Hereafter since Adam’s children had worldly food, drink, and marriage; after three appeals God refused to equate those He created by hand with one brought into being by “Be,” then Abdullah recited these verses.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r1.anchor: عن عبد الله بن عمرو قال: قالت الملائكة: يا رب، جعلت لبني آدم الدنيا فهم يأكلون ويشربون ويتزوجون

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.speaker: عثمان بن سعيد الدارمي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.claim: Al-Darimi’s version in Refutation of the Jahmiyya says God will not equate the righteous offspring of one created by His hand with one He created by saying “Be.”
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p517/r2.anchor: في كتابه: "الرد على الجهمية"، ولفظه: فقال الله عز وجل

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.claim: One account makes the early, persistent doers of good the foremost brought near; late repenters the people of the right; and those who persist in youthful evil the people of the left.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r2.anchor: وقيل : الناس ثلاثة فرجل ابتكر الخير في حداثة سنه ، ثم داوم عليه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.claim: أولئك المقربون is the predicate; the sound pause is after the second السابقون, completing the clause in parallel with the other groups.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r6.anchor: ووقف بعضهم على : والسابقون ؛ وابتدأ السابقون أولئك المقربون

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r7.claim: The brought-near have elevated ranks in Paradise close to the Throne.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p456/r7.anchor: الذين قربت درجاتهم في الجنة من العرش وأعليت مراتبهم

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.speaker: الكلبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.claim: They raced to faith in worldly life and will race to Paradise in the afterlife; these are the near ones.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r26.anchor: أحدهما : السابقون في الدنيا إلى الإيمان ، السابقون في الآخرة إلى الجنة هم المقربون ، قاله الكلبي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.claim: Another possibility is that those first to believe in their respective prophets are the foremost and near ones among their communities.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p446/r27.anchor: الثاني : يحتمل أنهم المؤمنون بالأنبياء في زمانهم , وسابقوهم بالإيمان هم المقربون المقدمون منهم .

MUQATIL:56:7-18/r5.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:56:7-18/r5.speaker: author
MUQATIL:56:7-18/r5.claim: The brought-near are close to God in rank and excellence.
MUQATIL:56:7-18/r5.anchor: عند الله تعالى في الدرجات والفضائل

NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r1.claim: Nasafi judges the first parsing of “the foremost” as predicate more apt than treating it as emphatic repetition.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p207#2/r2.claim: The foremost are those brought near to Allah.

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.speaker: شميط بن عجلان
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.claim: Shumayṭ ibn ʿAjlān describes three endings: persistent early goodness makes one a foremost intimate; repentance after sin makes one of the right; persistence in sin makes one of the left.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r13.anchor: وقال شميط بن العجلان: الناس ثلاثة فرجل ابتكر للخير في حداثة سنه داوم عليه

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.claim: One analysis makes the first al-sābiqūn a subject, the second an emphatic repetition, and “those are the brought-near” the predicate.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r15.anchor: ثم قيل: { السابقون } رفع بالابتداء والثاني توكيد له والخبر { أولئك المقربون }.

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.speaker: الزجاج
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.claim: Al-Zajjāj instead makes the first al-sābiqūn the subject and the second its predicate: those who precede in obedience also precede to God's mercy; verse 11 describes them.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r16.anchor: وقال الزجاج: { السابقون } رفع بالابتداء والثاني خبره والمعنى السابقون إلى طاعة الله

QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r17.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r17.claim: A report says that when one of the foremost intimates leaves his home in Paradise, his light makes him recognizable to those below him.
QURTUBI-FULL:56:8-11/r17.anchor: وقيل: إذا خرج رجل من السابقين المقربين من منزله في الجنة كان له ضوء
